_about: Operator-curated supplements to the auto-discovered service registry. Auto-discovered fields are preserved; manual entries are merged in. Reasons we need this file: (a) Route53 cross-cluster URLs aren't hardcoded in code (platform-eng confirms over Slack), (b) some services serve under different URL prefixes than their name suggests, (c) acronym aliases (llm = Loan Lifecycle Manager).

lending-lifecycle-manager-ms.notes: Cross-cluster callers (Aura in AI cluster, etc.) MUST use the .lending-v2prod.internal URL; the .jupiter.svc.cluster.local form only resolves from inside jupiterprod.

deposit-manager-ms.notes: LEGACY. Active deposit service is now deposit-platform-blostem in investmentprod. Some consumers (banking/dcms, gateway/graphQL) still reference cbs:9026; their Feign clients (e.g. gateway/graphQL/InvestmentDepositClient.kt) may declare paths that no longer exist on the deployed instance — verified 2026-05-29.

deposit-platform-blostem.notes: ACTIVE deposit service (replaces legacy deposit-manager-ms). v2 variants of several endpoints (e.g. /deposit/v2/order/{depositId}, /deposit/v2/fixed-deposit/create) also exist.
